svg.text: Flamingo.exe plus 13 plug-in DLLs, loaded in three batches: at startup, after the first sign-in, on first use

g.text: UI translations: zh-TW, English, Japanese, Korean
P2P links: direct, hole punching, relay fallback
Calls, remote desktop, screen sharing, recording
Lock the screen from the tray, five animations
Image text recognition, preloaded in background
Markdown parsing, layout and export, preloaded
Share local disks, folders and files in a chat
E2E secret chat · capture-proof · memory only
Management UI for group and personal bots
Voice captions: streaming ASR · editor · export
Speech model, loaded from memory, never unpacked

svg.text: Win32 + WTL · balloonui UI · Source/ in layers
One host per plug-in: load the DLL, check the API version, add its entries
Plug-ins call back through host interfaces: logging, translation, sending frames
Current user · accounts · config · group roles
Logging · i18n · fonts and images · code lexer
CIUSocket long-lived connection: v2 protocol · JSON · libsodium
Forwards frames by cmd range to plug-ins as-is, without parsing them:
File / image upload and download · Threading/ thread pool and background tasks
Process entry · CAppShell orders startup, shutdown and plug-in load / unload
Tray icon and tray menu · hidden main window · crash dumps
ChatImage/ · ChatFile/ · Avatar/ images, files and avatars
config/flamingo.ini server addresses and branding text
Started after an update package is downloaded;
unzips it over the installation directory.
Uses a %TEMP% copy of the language pack (--lang)
